title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Wait of the World
A violent gang member asks to move back to general population, following six years in segregation; a brother and sister are charged with murdering a high school football star, two years after he was stabbed to death on an Oakland street corner.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E5 — Close Quarters
The vast majority of inmates live in two-man cells but even with careful screening, conflicts can still arise between cellmates; one inmate covers up his own beating, and plucked from death row, another inmate tries to make a difference.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Blood Lines
An inmate takes drastic action and leaves his cell in a bloody mess; dangerous contraband is found on another inmate at Florida's Santa Rosa Correctional Institution.

title: Lockup: Santa Rosa: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Troubled Waters
A massive search for contraband throughout the facility turns up the heat on two inmates inside the Santa Rosa Correctional Institution; a convict prompts an evacuation when he floods his housing unit.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Sufferin' County
A female inmate finds romance with an alleged gang leader and the jailhouse prepares for a wedding; a very powerful inmate must make a choice between his crime family and his real family.

title: Lockup: Long Island: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — No More Franks And Beans
A first time inmate says he must turn to violence to avoid becoming a victim, an accused rapist gets into more trouble in jail and what he does next has some questioning his motives.

title: Lockup: Oakland: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Permanent Scars
An inmate says a bet for two cups of soup led to a horrific slashing; a case of road rage results in a murder charge for a software engineer; after two years in jail, a jury will decide if he must go to prison for life.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Crackdown
When Travis Trani took charge in 2008 he oversaw the implementation of several new policies; the restrictions on movement were among the toughest; inmates from the six different housing units could no longer freely move throughout the prison.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — Love Hurts
Even for inmates serving hard time, love can be a strong motivator; in prison, reaching out to others can be a dicey proposition; some inmates just don't know when someone's getting too close until it's too late.
